account: The OECD AI Incidents entry summarizes press coverage of 20 and 21 September 2022 (The Guardian, Mother Jones, The Register and others, not among the sources). It says that Germany is deploying AI-powered camera systems developed by IdentiFlight to detect endangered lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades to prevent collisions. The monitor's rationale cites the 82% reduction reported from the Wyoming study rather than a German measurement. OekoFor and ARSU compare camera detections with observations by ornithologists at German test sites. OekoFor’s dated updates report completion of red-kite validation in October 2021 and publication of a white-tailed eagle assessment in May 2023. These updates do not establish a German fatality-reduction estimate or the start date of the lesser spotted eagle tests.

ai_role.statement: The German tests compared IdentiFlight detections with ornithologists’ observations. OekoFor’s updates document validation milestones but do not measure a reduction in bird fatalities. The Wyoming effect estimate cannot establish the benefit in Germany.

fields.account: The OECD AI Incidents entry summarizes press coverage of 20 and 21 September 2022 (The Guardian, Mother Jones, The Register and others, not among the sources). It says that Germany is deploying AI-powered camera systems developed by IdentiFlight to detect endangered lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades to prevent collisions. The monitor's rationale cites the 82% reduction reported from the Wyoming study rather than a German measurement. OekoFor and ARSU compare camera detections with observations by ornithologists at German test sites. OekoFor’s dated updates report completion of red-kite validation in October 2021 and publication of a white-tailed eagle assessment in May 2023. These updates do not establish a German fatality-reduction estimate or the start date of the lesser spotted eagle tests.
